newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Venepal completes $12 mln ADR issue.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Venepal completes $12 mln ADR issue.

text.p: Leading Venezuelan paper company Venepal has placed 5.6 billion ($11.9 million) worth of Global Depository Receipts (GDS), so completing its refinancing targets for the year, Venepal said.

The placement forms part of a larger financial plan for the year that has seen the company increase paid-up capital by three billion bolivars ($6.4 million), take out loans totaling some $20 million, and place some $6.4 million in bonds, the company said in a press release.
The refinancing plan has allowed the company to extend debt maturities, improve debt/asset ratios and commit to several investment plans, it added.
These include a corrugated paper plant in Puerto Rico, and the Veneston woodchip plant in eastern Venezuela that will export up to one million tonnes per year.
U.S. Stone Container Corp and the Onofre Group Ltd hold 34 percent of Venepal's paid-up capital.
